title: Asian Senior Concerns Foundation 亞裔銀髮族關懷基金會(西雅圖)
content_html: The Asian Senior Concerns Foundation is a nonprofit organization established in 2001 in Seattle, Washington, founded by physicians, lawyers, accountants, engineers, and scholars from Taiwan. The foundation works to plan and provide resources for Asian Americans approaching or in retirement, helping them enjoy a secure, comfortable, healthy, and happy later life. It combines governmental and community resources to serve the senior Asian American population. Members volunteer their time outside of busy professional careers to research and share information on financial security, suitable housing, physical health, and peace of mind for elderly Asian Americans. The foundation’s long-term vision includes building a service network and retirement community suited to the needs of Asian seniors.
